narrative_purpose: Show that the entire body of navigational knowledge is stored in trained voice and memory rather than in any instrument or chart, by putting an elder teaching apprentices in a gondola where no device of any kind appears.
subject: An elder blue-skinned humanoid figure with a long grey-streaked braid sits cross-legged, head slightly raised and mouth open in mid-chant, both hands lifted and tracing shapes in the air in front of them, fingers spread and palms turned as if laying out something layered. Facing them, two younger blue-skinned figures sit close together, leaning slightly forward, watching the elder's hands intently, silent and still. All three wear close-fitting layered dark cloth wrappings with fine woven patterning.
scene: Night interior of a small woven gondola: walls of pale lashed fibre and timber, rigging lines rising out of frame at the corners, a low woven floor with rolled bundles and coiled cordage pushed to the sides. Beyond one open gap in the weave, black night air and a few faint stars. In the air immediately around the elder's moving hands hangs a faint cyan bioluminescent haze, thin drifting motes gathering loosely into three soft horizontal bands at different heights and a scatter of small separate points of light above them — an impression only, formless, glowing, with no edges, no shapes, no figures and nothing drawn.
camera: Intimate three-quarter interior shot at seated eye level, close enough to read all three faces and the elder's hands, the gondola's walls framing the group.
light: Warm ember amber from a small low lamp on the gondola floor lighting the faces from below; cool cyan bioluminescent haze around the elder's hands as the secondary source; deep indigo shadow filling the rest of the interior.
palette: Deep indigo interior shadow dominating; one warm amber pool on the three faces; restrained cyan glow around the hands; deep muted blue skin tones.
style: Painterly naturalist figure group, quiet and intimate, the energy of a lesson being given rather than a ritual performed.
detail_level: Crisp on the three faces and the elder's hands; the woven walls softened; the bioluminescent haze kept deliberately soft, formless and unresolved.
composition: Elder on the left in three-quarter view, the two apprentices on the right facing them, the glowing haze in the gap between. Keep the dark upper-right interior above the apprentices plain, unlit and low-detail so overlaid callouts read cleanly.
consistency_notes: Absolutely no instrument, chart, map, drawn specimen study or written symbol anywhere in frame — that absence is the entire point of the figure. The bioluminescent haze must stay an unresolved suggestion of bands and points of light, never resolving into a readable specimen study or any glyph. Cool Pandora palette with a single scarce warm amber interior accent.
